summary: Shows the Desk page in the visitor's chosen language by quietly sending the request to the matching language page.
purpose: It makes the Desk appear in English or Hindi without a page redirect, and without making the page slower to load.
why: Likely reason: a rewrite keeps the address the same and lets the page stay prebuilt.
how: It reads the language cookie, falls back to English if the cookie is missing or unsupported, and rewrites the request to the matching Desk page. It applies only to the Desk path.
inputs: The incoming request and its language cookie.
outputs: A rewritten request that points to the language page.
risks: Each supported language needs its own prebuilt Desk page, or visitors will see an error.
debug: If a language shows the wrong page, check the cookie value and the language page folders. If a language is missing, check that its page exists.
